h.partcraft.place: Place as bodies in the viewport
h.partcraft.none: There are no members to place: lay a roof out first.
h.partcraft.pick: Take outline from the selected sketch
h.partcraft.nosketch: Select a sketch feature with a closed outline (the roof's plan) in the feature tree first.
h.partcraft.noloop: The selected sketch has no closed loop of three or more corners.
h.partcraft.limit.bodies: PartCraft: the trusses are display bodies in the viewport, kept in the part file but not part of the part's solid: no boolean, mass, STEP or picking. The set leaves through this add-on's STL, OBJ, CSV and jig exports.
h.partcraft.limit.roofs: PartCraft has no roofs to read: type the roof outline, or take it from a sketch. Hips and valleys come from the straight skeleton of that outline at one pitch; per-edge pitches and gables need BimCraft's roof tool.
